checks.text: No order posts on its own with any field wrong (reference, stops, dates, window, equipment, temperature, weight, pallets, hazmat, accessorials).
Hazmat, duplicates, changes, cancellations, unclear orders and non-orders never post on their own.
A clean, complete order posts on its own instead of waiting for an operator.
Every order field is read right, whether or not the order posts.
A held email is held for the reason an operator needs to act on.
The order is filed under the account that sent it.
The note tells an operator, in plain words, what the shipper asked for (or what the email is, if it is not an order), why it was not entered automatically, and exactly what to check or do next.

cases.title: Hazmat with a UN number and class

operator_note_usable.reason: The note says plainly what was ordered and that it was held as hazmat, which matches the code. It gives concrete next steps (check the SDS, confirm the carrier and driver are hazmat-qualified, arrange placards and papers), and every fact comes from the email, the SDS or the sender's domain.

applied_rules: Hazmat flagged true with UN1263; route to operator for SDS and placard check before booking

It is held because the load is hazardous material. Review the attached SDS against the stated UN1263 / Class 3 / PG II details, then confirm the assigned carrier and driver are hazmat-qualified and that placards and shipping papers are arranged before entering the order.
